t: Real Research Today: Orbital Governance Councils
title: Real Research Today: Orbital Governance Councils
definition: Today's documented research behind Orbital Governance Councils.
description:
The road to Orbital Governance Councils is already being paved. Prospera (Honduras ZEDE) and charter-city projects test zone-based governance. Citizens' assemblies (Ireland, France, Belgium) show sortition-based deliberation shaping national policy.

Computational law research (Stanford CodeX) encodes regulation as executable rules. Together these programs form the station treaties foundation that Orbital Governance Councils will build on — the council logistics results, the traffic rules methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as council logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Orbital Governance Councils Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Orbital Governance Councils: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Orbital Governance Councils — councils governing stations and habitats.

Phase 1 — Prove (station treaties): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (council logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (traffic rules): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (rescue duties): council hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and orbit-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
